Thismorning, I measured it the more precise way, so yesterday's total may have been a little low (maybe by as much as a tenth of an inch or so) This was quite the event and even though this rain was desperately needed, it was a bit excessive. The height of this whole event was early yesterday morning when a mesocyclone moved right over us with some very high winds that lasted a couple of minutes (10/14 at 0150CDT). Otherwise, just wave after wave of heavy rain with occasional to frequent thunder. There was a bit of a break during the afternoon to early evening hours before the rain ramped up again during the evening to overnight hours. Only occasional rumbles of thunder noted. Thismorning as of 0730, mild but very humid and more showers moving in soon.
